notes: PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 4. Nice symmetric burn, some soot at 10 cm/s, Steady spreading, flame seems to reach a steady length. Decreasing flow shrinks flame and changes to mostly blue, but still spreading. Gets very dim near end of sample as it shrinks and extinguishes at burnout. Don noted the fiberglass matrix was still intact after the burn.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 5. Don noted significant vapor jetting. Flame not very long , but very sooty. Don set up a 2nd still camera taking pictures 1/s at F7, Aperture priority, spot metering on center of sphere in brackets of 3. Don noted equatorial division between 'charred' front like coating on meterorites, and matt black sooty rear hemispheres. Broke igniter. 2 minute burn.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 6. Very bright sooty ball. Lots of vapor jetting. N2 on at 1 minute. Blew off stagnation region but N2 did not extinguish wake, even with air flow off. Don turned off air, then N2 after some seconds. Wake flame sooty and wind-blown. Only extinguishes when all flow stops. N2 is entraining air to flame zone. Don noted that there was no soot on the sphere, just the 'char layer'. ~ 2 minute total burn.
PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 7. ~ 40 s burn, Don asked if images were too saturated, Paul said OK. Don set up 2nd still camera for additional images.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 8. ~ 60 s burn, Don said he like to watch solid samples burn in space and it makes him appreciate that he wouldn't want to be be there in a real fire - it wouldn't be pretty.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 9. same sphere as previous. Did not remove soot. Don again has 2nd still camera set up. Picked -4 ev for next test based on a quick scroll of these images.
PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 10. Filter on test. Don didn't reset the camera trigger, so only got 100 frames.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 11. No filter on this test. Don didn't reset the camera trigger, so only got 100 frames. Very low flows possible (AIR reading 0) at FAN 42. Apparent at end with N2 extinguishment. Flame doesn't go out until fan goes to 38.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 12. sample 18 and 19 mix up on names. Logging actual sample barcode used here. Grew from blue flame to sooty envelope flame. To extinguish, turned flow off, and flame turned to blue sphere expanding upwind with a few soot particles.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 13. Still a sooty flame even at 1 cm/s. Turned blue and extinguished when fan off, lots of vapor jetting during extinguishment. Lots of fuel vapor flushed out of duct when extinguished.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 14. Burning laminar but sooty at 42, turned down very slowly to 41 and flame started to turn blue and vapor jet. Turned fan to max, and flame did not blow off stagnation region. Burning rate incredibly fast. Turned off flow right when fuel completely ran out. Don examined igniter and there is one thin spot, so may not last much longer.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 15. Originally identified sample as 7, but 7 was last one left on GMT 222. Don commented on blue outer zone noted with yellow inside. Don asked about a flash right after ignition. He checked igniter and it was still intact. Burned sample on video at 14:59. Long flame, probably not a steady size. No recirculation zone formed downstream of sample. 26 s burn.
PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 16. Huge ignition kernel, then rest of video very dim. 1 cm wide sample. Don noted a flash on the top side late in test.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 17. Ignited and burned for only 2 s. Died when igniter turned off. Repeated re-ignition attempts failed. Don didn't want it to burn since their flight suits are made of this stuff. He felt like he should have left the igniter on longer. Fan cal and GN2 cal at ~16:00

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 18. No Don camera. Wake flame very dim on video, all blue, spread very slowly upwind. Ignited GBX time 16:14:44, N2 on at 16:17:18, did not extinguish, increased to pot 10, at 16:18:37, N2 off at 16:19:19. Accidentaly turned fan up briefly instead of N2. Fan turned to 40 at 16:19:22, flame and flame went out at 16:19:34. All times GBX.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 19. difficult to ignite,very dim blue, got some soot at 16:33:51 gbx time, N2 on at 34:18, soot faded a bit, still have a pimple of soot, N2 off at 34:48, fan 42:35:04, all blue flame again, like blue crescent moon. Fan off at 35:30 ish. Flame extinuishes right away. Don noted no soot deposition on the sphere. Just has bubbles.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 20. Adjusted igniter closer. LOS after fan change, 17:36 fan to 43. (MSG time). Came back at 17:39:40 or so. Don described it as flame was taking off growing around sphere, LE blue, trailing soot. Illuminating circumference of sphere. Vapor jetting just starting to do that when turned off fan, and it extinguished right away. MSG playback started at 17:37 during session (1:27 into downlink video).

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 21. readjusted igniter again. Fan 41 at 17:54:20 ish. Very dim blue flame. When he turned flow down to 40.5ish flame extinguished.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 22. bonus test. LOS partway through burn. Don instructed to let it burn about 2 minutes then turn fan off. Did not get playback during session. Requested it. Fan cal done at end of session. Playback occurred GMT 181:11:12. Started out all blue, got a pimple of soot. Long sooty tail at high flow. Extinguished when flow turned off.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 23. new 1 cm sphere. Got sooty quickly, overexposed still images on main SLR camera. Don has 2nd bonus camera set up too., Burned about 3 min. Turbulent vapor jetting, quite sooty. Change camera settings for next test.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 24. ignited within 15 s (still hot?), sooting by 35 s, fully engulfed by ~ 1 min. Extinguished when pot ~ 39. Camera settings much better.
PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 25. Don says sphere is ~ 0.7 cm. Igniter has hot spot. Bar code 015M. Nice images. All blue sphere just before extinction.

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 26. Igniter too far away 2st attempt 15:48. Igniter broke on 2nd attempt 15:51. New igiter. Ignited at 16:05 turned flow down to ~40.5 ish, and flame got very spherical, alternating blue and orange?(filter on)

PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 27. preheated by briefly heating igniter wire then hitting it full, did not ignite but smoked . He said it popped up about 1 mm due to residueal spring tension. Will readjust it again.
PSI-26_Science Documents_As Run_Test Matrix.xlsx, 'as run matrix', row 28. 12 pulses and then on, no joy. Not even much smoke.
